title: Dream band: pianists, Oliver, Bechet, guitar, trombone, bass and drums
summary: She picks her ideal band, with Fats Waller or Earl Hines on piano, King Oliver or Freddie Keppard on cornet, Sidney Bechet, Lonnie Johnson on guitar, and Eddie Garland on bass.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom
